title: light argentinian nuts tart
description: a grassy, crumbly, light argentinian dish featuring nuts and a touch of flambe, suitable for ayurvedic-sattvic diets. perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: coconut sugar for a more sattvic option

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.notes: ground, for added warmth and depth

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.notes: gluten-free, for a more sensitive gut

ingredients.name: coconut oil
ingredients.notes: coconut oil for a more sattvic option

instructions: mix the ground almonds, hazelnuts, and walnuts in a medium bowl.
soak the dried apricots in water for at least 4 hours. drain and chop them coarsely.
whisk the eggs in a large bowl, adding the brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
add the flour and mix until a dough forms. knead for 5-7 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.
press the dough into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
arrange the chopped nuts and dried apricots on top of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
drizzle the melted coconut oil over the nuts and apricots.
bake the tart for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
